title: Termix authorization table
description: Who may call each route and socket. Read by scripts/authz/run.mjs.

seed.description: Requests run before the matrix, usually as the owner, to make the rows that id routes point at.

capture.description: Fixture name to a dotted path in the reply. -1 picks the last item of a list.

routes.description: Keys are "METHOD /path", with WS for sockets.

access.description: public: anyone. user: any full session. admin: admins only.

permission.description: Permission or permissions the caller needs. A permission the plain user role lacks means only admins.

resource.description: The owner's resource the route acts on. host and folder follow share levels, credential follows use and manage, anything else is the owner's alone.

key.description: The body and query field that carries the id, when it is not in the path.

admin.description: Whether an admin may reach another user's resource. Unchecked when left out.

params.description: Path param to a fixture name, or =literal.

allow.description: Session states let through: pending, setup or guest.

expect.description: Overrides the derived outcome for single identities.

allowed.description: any: allowed cells are not checked (no test data or desktop only). Refusals still are.

filtered.description: Refused callers may get a 2xx as long as nothing of the owner's is in it.

scoped.description: Refused callers may get a no-op 2xx; afterwards the owner's copy is checked.

refuse400.description: Why a 400 counts as a refusal here: the body names something of the owner's.

send.description: Socket messages sent once open, to reach a check made per message.

refuseReply.description: Pattern that marks a socket reply as a refusal.

destructive.description: Never called as an allowed caller.

callAllowed.description: Call this write as allowed callers too.

unlisted.description: Why this route is not in the served list (desktop only, served at /sync).

skip.description: Not called at all; say why.
